subject: general
question: How long will it take for Rs. 1,500 to become ₹2,040 at 6% per annum simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 1,500

Amount (A) = Rs. 2,040

Rate of interest (R) = 6% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

Time (T) = SI × 100 / (P × R)

**Calculation:**

SI = A - P

SI = 2040 - 1500

SI = 540

Time (T) = (540 × 100) / (1500 × 6)

⇒ T = 54000 / 9000

⇒ T = 6

**It will take 6 years for Rs. 1,500 to become Rs. 2,040 at 6% per annum simple interest.**
